propositions: On platforms without /proc, _process_start_time always returns None, making the recycled-pid discriminant unsatisfiable and causing locks held by dead processes with recycled pids to be judged fresh indefinitely
The fix applies _mkdir_lock_age_exceeds_ceiling on the live-pid branch only when current_start is unavailable, bounding an otherwise unbounded wedge to the 1-hour ceiling
A genuinely live owner holding the exclusive fcntl leg cannot be reclaimed because reaching _mkdir_lock_is_stale requires first acquiring that leg, making the ceiling safe for orphans only
The owner-identity and lock-staleness logic was extracted from lock.py (798 LOC) into a new lock_owner.py module to comply with the 800-line file size limit while preserving one-way dependency
